catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class removes one named model from a simulated world. cap.world.reset.v1 resets a whole scenario and cap.world.step.v1 advances ticks; neither binds gazebo_msgs/DeleteModel. The pinned remove_object.py calls that acknowledged service, so this extension preserves its contract.

No catalogue class publishes one gazebo_msgs/ModelState on /gazebo/set_model_state. cap.motion.cartesian_pose.v1 is an arm pose in millimetres with an execution result, and cap.world.step.v1 advances fixed ticks; neither carries a ModelState publication. The pinned move_object.py publishes ModelState without an acknowledgement, so this extension preserves that contract.
